job_title: React / Next.js Developer Needed to Convert Figma Design (Pixel-Perfect)
job_summary: Description: I have the complete Figma design ready for my new website and I’m looking urgently for an experienced React or Next.js developer to develop it exactly as designed in Figma (pixel-perfect). The project has already been started, and the existing codebase is available on GitHub. I will provide full access and can actively assist you to understand the structure and expectations. Key requirements: - Strong experience with React and/or Next.js - Ability to deliver 100% Figma-accurate implementation - Clean, scalable, and well-structured code - Comfortable working with an existing GitHub repository Good communication and ability to work fast (this is urgent) Important: I am not looking for approximations or “close enough” results. The final output must match the Figma design exactly (spacing, typography, components, layouts, responsiveness). What I will provide: - Full Figma file - Access to GitHub repository - Clear guidance and availability for questions Please include in your proposal: - Examples of Figma → React/Next.js projects you’ve completed - Your availability to start immediately - Which stack you recommend (React or Next.js) and why Looking forward to working with someone reliable who can deliver high-quality work fast.
